question: What will be the closing value of front-month silver futures (SI=F on Yahoo Finance) on September 5, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the daily close of SI=F on Yahoo Finance for 2026-09-05. If there is no close on that date (weekend or holiday), the last close before it is used.
research:
I couldn't get an exact Aug 21 close: the Yahoo SI=F page and most article pages refused my connections, so the figures below come from search-result summaries. On those, silver was about $68 on Aug 21, up from about $62 at the start of August.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source is SI=F on Yahoo Finance, using its daily close. The quote and history pages refused my connection, so I could not read the latest close from Yahoo directly.
- Sept 5, 2026 is a Saturday, so in practice the **Friday, Sept 4 close** decides it. (Labor Day falls on Mon, Sept 7.)
- SI=F follows the front-month contract and usually switches from the September to the December contract in late August. The December contract normally trades a bit above September, so expect a small upward step when it switches.
- 2026-08-21: Yahoo's daily article says the September contract (SI=F) opened at **$68.20**, "Silver pushes higher on weaker dollar." [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-friday-august-21-2026-silver-pushes-higher-on-weaker-dollar-161325787.html)
- A Trading Economics headline from around this time reads "Silver Holds Above $68 Ahead of Fed's Jackson Hole Speech." [TE](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/silver/news/578675)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. It depends on the price over about 10 trading days, Aug 24 to Sept 4.
- On these figures, silver is about $68, roughly in the middle of the question's $40 to $100 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-21: Silver rose on a weaker dollar and opened at $68.20. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-friday-august-21-2026-silver-pushes-higher-on-weaker-dollar-161325787.html)
- 2026-08-20: Silver opened higher at about $67.08 after the Treasury announced larger debt buybacks. Commentary links those buybacks to a weaker dollar and to worries about US debt. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-thursday-august-20-2026-silver-opens-higher-on-treasurys-news-of-increased-debt-buybacks-153635987.html)
- 2026-08-18: Silver opened at $65.90, down 0.5%, as investors weighed inflation and geopolitical risks. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-tuesday-august-18-2026-silver-price-holds-as-investors-weigh-inflation-and-geopolitical-risks-155200076.html)
- 2026-08-17: Silver was supported by softer economic data, while the industrial-demand outlook remained uncertain. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-monday-august-17-2026-buoyed-by-softer-economic-data-while-industrial-outlook-remains-uncertain-135247624.html)
- 2026-08-11: Silver opened above $65 for the first time since June, helped by jobs data and news on Iran. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-tuesday-august-11-2026-silver-prices-keep-rising-on-jobs-iran-news-120655913.html)
- 2026-08-11: CME said it will extend 24/7 trading to 100-ounce silver futures from Sept 11, pending regulatory review. [CME](https://www.cmegroup.com/media-room/press-releases/2026/8/11/cme_group_to_expand247tradingto100-ouncesilverfuturesaftergoldss.html)
- 2026-08-10: Silver opened at $63.80. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-monday-august-10-2026-silver-prices-keep-rising-this-morning-124241793.html)
- 2026-08-07: Silver opened at $61.85 after a disappointing jobs report reduced the odds of a Fed rate hike. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-friday-august-7-2026-silver-surge-continues-as-jobs-report-disappoints-124342659.html)
- 2026-08-05: Spot silver was about $61.58, up 3.5% on the day. [USAGold](https://www.usagold.com/live-silver-price-today.html)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Early 2026 to late June: silver hit a record in January. Sources disagree on the peak: about $90 to $93.70 in most sources, $121.64 in one. It then fell more than 33% very quickly. [IndMoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/why-are-silver-prices-rising), [Motilal Oswal](https://www.motilaloswal.com/news/commodities/12333)
- 2026-05-27: the July contract closed at $74.89. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/personal-finance/investing/article/silver-prices-today-thursday-may-28-2026-opening-lower-this-morning-after-us-targets-iranian-drones-110901804.html)
- Late June 2026: a snapshot of the SI=F page showed about $58.16, with a day range of $56.40 to $58.43. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/SI=F/%22)
- Trend: silver has risen from about $58 in late June to about $68 by Aug 21, roughly 17%. Most of that gain came in August.
- Typical move (my own rough calculation, not from a source): silver's realized volatility in 2026 has been very high. At an assumed 45 to 55% annualized, one standard deviation over 10 trading days is about 9 to 11%, or roughly ±$6 to $7.5 from $68. Daily moves of 2 to 3.5% have been common this month.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi price for a market dated on or before Aug 22 that targets Sept 4/5. Kalshi lists hourly silver markets but no relevant contract I could use. [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxsilverh/silver-hourly/kxsilverh-26sep0920)
- Mid-2026 bank views:
  - Morgan Stanley's Kolanovic warned silver could fall back to $50 if speculative positions unwind.
  - Morgan Stanley expects a 2027 average of $85.
  - UBS has a $70 call.
  [IndMoney](https://www.indmoney.com/blog/us-stocks/why-are-silver-prices-rising), [ad-hoc-news](https://ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/unternehmensnachrichten/ubs-s-70-dollar-silver-call-rests-on-ai-demand-outweighing-margin-calls-and-solar-cutbacks/70408709)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late August (about Aug 26 to 28): SI=F switches from the September to the December contract. Sept first notice day and options expiry fall around then too. [goldsilver.com](https://goldsilver.com/industry-news/goldsilver-news/comex-silver-first-notice-day/)
- Aug 27 to 29: the Jackson Hole symposium. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gives his first keynote there, Fri Aug 28 at about 10:00 ET. Markets are watching the risk of a rate hike, and a BofA survey found 69% of fund managers expect a neutral tone. [Newsquawk](https://www.newsquawk.com/headlines/full-jackson-hole-symposium-schedule), [RexShares](https://www.rexshares.com/jackson-hole-explained/), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/fed-chair-kevin-warsh-to-address-inflation-at-jackson-hole-symposium)
- Late August: the PCE inflation report, as usually scheduled (I did not confirm the date).
- Fri Sept 4: the August jobs report, due on the same day as the deciding close. The previous jobs report moved silver noticeably.
- Ongoing:
  - US-Iran tensions.
  - Treasury buybacks and the dollar.
  - Pressure on industrial and solar demand.
- The Sept FOMC meeting comes after the resolution date.
